candidateDiscoveryRules: Discover active, unshadowed decision ai_will_do definitions through the shared index.
eligibilityRules: Evaluate source eligibility and declared candidate overrides with three-valued logic.
adapter.evaluationCadence: decision AI evaluation cadence; selection probability is not modeled
limitations: Decision scores are not normalized without a documented complete selection rule.
modifierOrder: Evaluate the base expression, then source add/factor operations and modifiers in source order.
Apply declared external factors only after source-local operations.
poolNormalizationRules: Return scores and ranks without inventing a categorical denominator.
scopeExpectations: country and target scopes declared by the scenario
supportedExpressions: scenario-bound ROOT/THIS/PREV/FROM scope chains, saved scopes, and event targets
declared dynamic scope-pool filters with uniform or proportional selection
timingConversion: No time-distribution conversion is claimed for this adapter.
unsupportedConstructs: Decision scores are not normalized without a documented complete selection rule.
